description: Traffic Disruptions is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset provides information about what's happening on Edmonton's roads that could impact your drive, including: Major road closures and detours, Road construction, Travel delays and special events that impact traffic. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are construction, detours, fcm2026, odd2022yeg, traffic. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
